preferences.name: backendDirectory
preferences.title: Backend Directory
preferences.description: Path to the Python backend (folder containing transcription_server.py and pyproject.toml)

preferences.name: serverPort
preferences.title: Server Port
preferences.description: Port for the local Whisper server (default: 51234)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
